name: God File
description: The AI generator kept adding unrelated content to a single file instead of honoring a proper separation of concerns.

name: Over-Abstraction
description: A trait, a factory and a service for everything, including things that are used exactly once.

name: Over-Engineering
description: A multi-stage pipeline with strategies and providers where a single plain function would do.

name: Comment Spam
description: Shouted section headers, ASCII architecture diagrams and jokes where readable code would suffice.

name: Orphaned Code
description: Commented-out code kept around for historical reasons, as if version control did not exist.

name: Magic Numbers
description: Unexplained numeric literals scattered through the logic instead of named constants.

name: Copy-Paste Programming
description: The same block duplicated across files with tiny variations instead of a shared helper.

name: Dead Code
description: Functions and branches that can never run, left behind because deleting felt risky.

name: Inconsistent Naming
description: The same concept called three different names depending on which file you are reading.

name: Giant Function
description: One function that parses, validates, computes and renders, daring you to read it all.

name: Boolean Trap
description: Bare true/false arguments at call sites that tell you nothing about what they switch.

name: Swallowed Errors
description: Failures caught and silently discarded, so broken states look exactly like working ones.

name: Lying Comments
description: Comments that confidently describe behavior the code next to them does not have.

name: Strange API
description: A public function returning a shape nobody can explain, kept that way because tests depend on it.

name: Stringly Typed
description: Structured data passed around as raw strings instead of the types sitting one import away.

name: Global State
description: Mutable state reachable from everywhere, so every bug could have come from anywhere.

name: Hardcoded Text
description: User-facing strings baked into the logic where constants or resources belong.

name: Premature Optimization
description: Hand-rolled caching and pooling around code that was never measured and never slow.

name: Dependency Bloat
description: A new dependency for every tiny job the standard library already does.

name: Flag Arguments
description: One function that does two different things depending on a boolean you pass it.

name: Any Everywhere
description: Every prop, event and helper typed as any while the validation schemas sit right there unused.

name: Assertion Spam
description: as-casts sprinkled over values the compiler rightly refused to accept.

name: Non-Null Spam
description: Trailing ! operators asserting values exist instead of handling the case where they do not.

name: Validation Bypass
description: Schemas are defined with zod and then ignored exactly where untrusted input arrives.

name: Index Keys
description: List items keyed by array index, so reordering the list scrambles the state.

name: Effect Abuse
description: Effects used for derived state and event handling that plain computation would cover.

name: Unwrap Everywhere
description: Results and options unwrapped along every path, turning recoverable errors into panics.

name: Panic Branches
description: Branches that panic on inputs the type system allowed, instead of returning an error.

name: Clone Spam
description: Values cloned at every step because reasoning about ownership felt like too much.

name: Module Spam
description: One file per tiny action, so reading a single operation means opening half the tree.

name: Stringly Parsing
description: Tokens re-parsed from display strings instead of carrying the structured value along.

name: Tests In The Library
description: The unit tests live inside the shipping library file, inflating the artifact they test.
